methodology: Fresh offline file:// contexts at 1280×720 and 1920×1080; browser errors and external requests fail acceptance.

Raids deploy to the default area (沿海街区, three maps) and run on the 2.5D view. Positions, inventories, enemy readiness and elapsed time are controlled fixtures (the ?test=1 driver and session candidates). E opening, closing, transfers, combat and extraction use real browser keys/mouse.

Pointer drags use displayed grid geometry; the panel takes the drop cell from the dragged item's top-left corner, so drags grab 6 px inside the item and release 6 px inside the target cell. Stale-drag checks close and replace the source while the mouse is held.
Quota injection starts at capture of the trusted pointerup event, so periodic saves remain writable until the transfer. Failed transfers compare inventories and the exact pre-drop session bytes.
The old-client storage-event fixture stops the raid renderer's ticker, preserving the open loot panel while excluding automatic checkpoints; it restarts after conflict detection.
Repeated refreshes restore matching container, corpse and carried inventories. Three consecutive completed runs verify lifecycle isolation. This is not a natural-play balance test.

firstFailure.cause: loot quiet() used placeEnemy(), which also overwrote the strict checkpoint home for the new seed44 blockade deployment. The next real SaveSession candidate correctly rejected that fixture.
firstFailure.repair: Keep frozen recovery/blockade program members at their native authored posts; retain other parking, strict decoding and all existing assertions. No product or artifact change.

steps.name: 25 enemies and original 60 loot entries remain conserved
pointer crate ↔ bag and crate ↔ safe transfers use exact displayed cells
stacks accept partial merges while multiple occupied targets and out-of-bounds shapes preserve items
full inventory rejects a shape overlapping multiple items atomically
swap rejects atomically when the original corner cannot fit the displaced gun in either orientation
external selection exposes no direct use or equip; double-click picks up without using or equipping
reopening preserves remaining loot and permits an empty container
Escape, Tab, E, close button and map clear loot context
pointer drag previews exact legal and illegal shapes; blur cancels the pending transfer
loot suppresses fire, reload, quick-use and sprint while clock and AI continue
a movement key leaves loot at once and walks; a key held into the window, typing, drags and other panels keep their rules (issue #26 F13)
actual enemy damage keeps loot open; a movement key gets the player out (issue #26 F13)
invalid range and rising tide close external inventory
failed writes roll back both directions and safe checkpoints; retry commits once
a held pointer drag cannot mutate a new source after the old context closes
scattered ground loot still uses immediate E pickup
real kill produces one searchable corpse; repeated damage never generates another
three refreshes restore remaining crate/corpse loot and never duplicate taken items
a real second-window storage event closes loot and protects the newer record
death while looting closes context, loses bag loot and retains safe loot
real three-second extraction keeps dragged container loot
timeout while looting closes context and resolves as failure
